messages:
mariam: Heads-up: running into a nagging parity issue in our rerank sampleapp. One item in small batches sometimes arrives with embedding length 1535 while others are 1536. Happens with the Python BatchHelper and Node EmbedPacker.

mariam: Quick sanity check: curl vs SDK. Curl always shows 1536/1536: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/embed-small","input":["a","b"]}' | jq '.data[].embedding | length'
```

mariam: curl output:
1536
1536

mariam: SDK (BatchHelper.map) prints:
len0=1536
len1=1535

alex: good isolate. if curl is correct then helper or local streaming/reshape is suspect. which SDK version?

mariam: py-sdk 1.5.0 (BatchHelper), node-sdk 0.14 (EmbedPacker). Repro is flaky but reproducible in CI.

kevin: two candidates: (1) helper reuses internal buffers and a resize/trim path drops one float; (2) auth retry / token refresh path triggers a second partial response and the iterator gets interleaved. If you can reproduce deterministically, enable SDK debug logs: REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 and attach bytes around the JSON boundary.

rui: workaround to unblock customers: set pad_to_multiple=64 (python) or AlignTo/AlignBytes=64 (Go/Node) or enable safeCopy on packer. That forces a copy and avoids slice/memoryview reuse.

mariam: setting pad_to_multiple=64 fixes it locally. We'll add that to onboarding notes until a patch lands.

alex: Kevin, can you add an e2e test that compares SDK output length vs curl/jq for small batches and add a fuzzed chunked-stream test to simulate partial chunk boundaries?

kevin: on it. Plan: in python helper, stop returning memoryviews when stream/fast-path is active; always materialize lists for each embedding. Add a retry-path test to ensure iterator reset doesn't leak partial chunks. Also add cross-sdk parity test in CI.

rui: I'll add a short FAQ blurb: "If embedding lengths differ vs curl, try pad_to_multiple/AlignTo or disable helper streaming; collect REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG logs and attach to issue."

devex-bot: build note: py-sdk embed-batcher-fix candidate pushed (sha: f1e2d3). Integration parity tests scheduled.

mariam: thanks all 1: will attach minimal repro to the issue once I upload it.
